claims.criteria: Comparison is limited to heel profile, stated height, toe shape, fastening, cushioning and source-labelled occasion. Comfort is explicitly treated as fit-dependent rather than guaranteed.
claims.statement: Block heels use a wider heel base; kitten heels use a slimmer, generally lower profile. Exact height and other specifications must be checked on the product page.

claims.criteria: Only current Inc.5 pages checked on 2026-07-22 are named. Price and stock are omitted because they change.
claims.statement: Three named Inc.5 products are mapped to use cases using their current heel height, heel type, toe shape, fastening, cushioning, material and occasion fields.

claims.criteria: Guidance repeats current size notes and care instructions without claiming universal fit or performance.
claims.statement: The named pages direct shoppers to the size chart, include a wider-feet sizing note, and recommend gentle cleaning, moisture avoidance and cool, dry storage.

claims.criteria: Height and occasion recommendations are explicitly framed as starting points based on the verified 2-inch kitten and 2.5-inch block examples; comfort and universal suitability are not claimed.
claims.statement: The buying guide compares current product-page measurements of 2 inches for two kitten-heel examples and 2.5 inches for the block pump, then maps heel base, height, fastening, venue and duration to office, wedding, Haldi/Mehendi, party and first-pair decisions.
